nina_cs: Onboarding sync w/ Vectorly. After key rotation their web clients show repeated 429s for ~2-3 minutes on initial ramp. They reported multiple tabs + a proxy in front of the SDK.

ash_sdk: are these 429s from /auth/preflight or model endpoints? any Retry-After?

nina_cs: mostly preflight. Retry-After sometimes 0, sometimes 1. They said proxy pools idle-conns and reuses sockets across tabs.

pete_eng: likely preflight fanout + proxy connection reuse causing bursts at auth tier. Proxy may be queueing and then flushing many requests together.

lara_support: quick mitigation: 1) temporary +40% onboarding burst window for 3h? 2) ask customer to add small client jitter and cap preflight concurrency.

onboard-bot: Quota change requested by lara_support for tenant vec-21: +40% burst for 3 hours (audit q-2026-1799).

ash_sdk: client snippet to coalesce refreshes: ```js
const sdk = new RedwoodSDK({ preflight: { maxConcurrent: 2, coalesceMs: 300 }, retry: { jitter: true, maxAttempts: 5, respectRetryAfter: true } });
```

pete_eng: I'll open INF-3555 to add metrics: tenant=vec-21 preflight.burst_count and proxy.flush_events.

max_sales: flagging renewal owner; if UX hit persists beyond onboarding we'll offer an eng session.

nina_cs: sending guide + scheduling 30m watch tomorrow 10am PT. Action owners: lara -> apply bump (done), pete -> infra ticket, ash -> client config doc, me -> watch session invite.

pete_eng: ticket INF-3555 created.
